stages.headline: In a system with three unknowns a solution is a triple (x; y; z) satisfying all three equations.

stages.headline: A 'triangular' system is solved bottom-up: first z, then y, then x.

stages.headline: In general, eliminate one unknown by substitution or addition to get a system in two unknowns.
